entries.text: Fixed `convolution`, `convolution_fft`, `convolution_ntt` and `convolution_int` so that convolving an empty sequence with any sequence returns `[]`. Previously `convolution([], [1, 2])` raised a `ValueError` and the FFT and NTT versions returned `[0]`.
